description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for handling time representations, conversions, and timezone operations in a cross-platform manner, including structures like EzTimeExploded, EzTimeT, EzTimeValue, and functions for getting current time, exploding and imploding time values, and conversions between different time formats.

methods.name: EzTimeTFromSbTime
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer representing SbTime to EzTimeT, with a lossy conversion.

methods.name: EzTimeTToSbTime
methods.description: Converts EzTimeT to a 64-bit integer representing SbTime.

methods.name: EzTimeTGetNow
methods.description: Retrieves the current time as EzTimeT.

methods.name: EzTimeTExplodeLocal
methods.description: Converts EzTimeT to local time exploded structure.

methods.name: EzTimeTExplodeUTC
methods.description: Converts EzTimeT to UTC time exploded structure.

methods.name: EzTimeTImplodeLocal
methods.description: Converts exploded local time to EzTimeT.

methods.name: EzTimeTImplodeUTC
methods.description: Converts exploded UTC time to EzTimeT.
